newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay sugar prices steady, moderate retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Bombay sugar prices steady, moderate retail buying.

text.p: Bombay sugar prices on Friday held steady on moderate consumer demand and retail buying, dealers said.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 was steady at 1,455/1,475 rupees per quintal and sugar M-30 at 1,480/1,524 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery also remained quiet at 1,390/1,400 rupees per quintal for the S-30 variety and at 1,405/1,420 rupees per quintal for the M-30 variety.
"Offerings by the millers remained low as local millers have already sold out most of the quantity of free sale quota allotted to them for the first half of July," one broker said.
"Limited offerings by millers has curtailed arrivals of sugar from mills to the market," he said.
Free sale quota for the current month is 750,000 tonnes against 800,000 tonnes released last month.
